description: Set a party's presidential-primary vote shares — one state, or MANY states in a single call. SINGLE STATE: pass `state` + `shares` (unchanged behavior; echoes the full running roll_up). BATCH: pass `states` = { "SC":…

include_rollup.description: BATCH mode only: also return the full delegate roll_up alongside the default trimmed `delta` summary. Ignored in single-state mode (which always echoes the full roll_up).

shares.description: SINGLE-STATE mode: Map of candidate_id → percentage (0-100), e.g. {"vance": 42, "desantis": 30}. Must reference set_primary_candidates ids. Empty ({}) un-models the state.

state.description: SINGLE-STATE mode: State FIPS ("19") or 2-letter abbr ("IA"). Provide `state`+`shares` OR `states`, not both.

states.description: BATCH mode: Map of state (FIPS or 2-letter abbr) → its {candidate_id: pct} shares, e.g. {"SC":{"newsom":31,"harris":24},"NH":{...}}. Writes all states in one atomic call; an invalid state fails the whole batch (nothing is written). Empty ({}) for a state un-models it.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: set_primary_shares
